# Version 4.150.1
> **Native rendering stability** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 corrects malformed native text cleanup and clipped render-pass stencil checks.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Malformed text-resource cleanup** — Fixes native allocator destruction order when corrupt serialized Slug data is rejected, avoiding use-after-free and invalid frees. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))
- **Clipped stencil checks** — Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
